selection_pool: 12 predeclared single-timeframe candidates; weekly reference and 15 ablations excluded from selection
eligibility: train>=20 trades, validation>=8 trades, both profit factor>1 and Sharpe>0; train maxDD>=-35%, validation maxDD>=-25%; >=3 of annual 2019/2020/2021/2022 training folds positive
score: min(train Sharpe, validation Sharpe) - 0.05 * optional entry conditions; tie fewer conditions then alphabetical
no_eligible: deploy CASH; separately report research-only candidate with best score meeting sample count
test_policy: freeze selection.json before evaluating 2025+; no changes selected from test outcomes; prior project research has seen these historical markets, so this is a within-study chronological holdout, not pristine unseen or live validation
uncertainty: paired circular block bootstrap, block length 20 calendar days, 4000 replications, seed 20261112; Holm adjustment across all 28 configurations for mean-return tests and 16 predeclared rule contrasts
sensitivity: selected research candidate only: slip 0/0.00025/0.0005/0.001/0.002, fees fixed 0.0005; adverse vs favorable daily ordering; fast/slow scale 0.8,1.2 and ATR trail 1.5,2.5; diagnostics cannot change selection
book_mapping: EMA13/26, MACD12/26/9, ATR14, 100-bar 95% envelope, support20, structural stop low5-.1ATR, next-open or next-bar stop/touch entries; fixed translations, not unique original-book formulas
notes: All positions liquidated with costs at predefined segment boundaries; prior data used only for indicator warmup, not carried positions. Annualization 365.25, cash risk-free rate zero, no lending/funding income, no leverage. Same-bar stop/target adverse ordering primary. Buy-stop/touch market order proxies are explicitly not exchange limit orders.
